title: Loyalty configuration
subtitle: Set how minglers earn and redeem points. Each rate has its own save button.
rangeHint: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.

earnRate.title: Earn rate
earnRate.pkrPerPointHelper: Minglers earn 1 point for every PKR {{value}} spent on a bill.
earnRate.per10BookingsHelper: Awarded as a milestone reward after every 10 completed bookings.
earnRate.perInviteHelper: Granted when an invited mingler joins and verifies their account.
earnRate.perReviewWithPhotoHelper: Granted when a mingler submits a review with at least one photo.
earnRate.perCaptainHelper: Awarded when a mingler claims the Crown Promingler role on an interest table.
earnRate.perShareHelper: Awarded when a mingler shares an interest table link from the app.

redeemRate.title: Redeem rate
redeemRate.pointsPerPkrHelper: {{value}} points equal PKR 1 of discount at checkout.
redeemRate.maxRedeemPercentHelper: Maximum portion of any single bill that can be paid with points.
